reins — MCP browser bridge CLI

Usage:
  reins login                 sign in to your Reins account (OAuth)
  reins logout                remove the stored token
  reins tools                 list every tool your account exposes
  reins call <tool> [json]    call any tool directly with a JSON arg object
  reins <command> [args]      run a friendly command (below)

Commands:
  browsers    list the browsers connected to your account
  select      select the browser to drive: reins select <browserId>
  tabs        list open tabs
  open        navigate the active tab: reins open <url>
  snapshot    snapshot the page's interactive elements (with refs)
  read        read the page as text
  click       click an element: reins click <ref|selector>
  type        type into the focused/target field: reins type <text> [--ref <r>]
  screenshot  capture a screenshot of the active tab
  console     read the page console logs
  eval        evaluate JS in the page: reins eval '<expr>'
  wait        wait for a condition: reins wait <selector>
  dumps       list captures (HARs/screenshots/PDFs) saved to your R2

Config:
  Endpoint  https://reins.vulcanos.pro  (override with REINS_ENDPOINT)
  Token     ~/.reins/config.json
